Multiple-Choice Question 1

A tenant signs a one-year written lease for an apartment. Halfway through the year the landlord sells the building to a buyer who knew about the lease.

Which of the following statements is correct about the buyer and the lease? Select one.

A. The buyer may evict the tenant immediately.

B. The buyer takes the building subject to the lease.

C. The lease ended automatically when the building was sold.

D. The tenant must sign a new lease with the buyer.

Question 1 Answer

The correct answer is (B).
